title: A -dirty ui pin passes the pin check, and fails only in CI
foundBy: agent review (session): `npm run registry:pack` on a tree with changes packs a -dirty build, and nothing stops a pin on one before CI fails on it

evidence.verified: In a scratch clone, the @codesweep-ai/ui version dispatch-viewer/app/package.json pins was given a `-dirty` suffix. Then `go run scripts/consumer-conventions.go` failed with exit status 1. It said the version is a build of a tree with changes, which no CI ever builds and no other machine can install. With the pin as committed, it passed. GitHub CI's `ci` passed on 8fd7503, once a macOS smoke job was run again: podman there had refused to start a container.

resolution: The pin check rejects a ui version ending in `-dirty` or `+dirty`, and says to pin a build of a commit instead.
details: `scripts/consumer-conventions.go` accepts any exact version as the ui pin, `-dirty` ones included. `npm run registry:pack` on a tree with changes packs such a build. A pin on one installs on the machine that made it and nowhere else, since no CI ever builds that version. CI then fails with E404, long after the commit.
